specification.objective: Prepare Magi 1.8.4 patch-release metadata and dated notes for the merged profile-context propagation change, without changing runtime behavior or dependencies; publish only after validation and CI pass.

requirements.statement: The plugin manifest, npm test-package metadata and lockfile root entries, README, and current compatibility-document titles consistently report Magi 1.8.4.
The dated 1.8.4 changelog section records the merged profile-context propagation change in Magi's profile-local IPC bridge and preserves the complete 1.8.3 and older history.

The metadata-only release preparation does not change runtime behavior or dependencies; the version/history characterization passes on both the locked baseline and target, and the full Python suite plus enabled coverage gate pass on the exact target tree.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The metadata test derives the current version from package.json, verifies every authoritative version source and the current dated changelog heading, and passes on the 1.8.3 baseline and 1.8.4 target.
The 1.8.4 changelog section dated 2026-10-30 describes the merged profile-context IPC change; the complete 1.8.3 and older history remains unchanged.
The same bash ci/test.sh characterization command passes on baseline and target; test.complete and coverage gates pass on the target, and ./verify.sh completes on the target.

invariants.statement: No runtime/plugin logic, dependency versions, Hermes configuration, credentials, or user memory data are changed.
The v1.8.3 release history and all earlier changelog sections remain intact; existing tags and releases are never moved or overwritten.
Create the v1.8.4 tag and hosted release only after source validation and required CI pass for the exact release commit.

forbidden_states.statement: Authoritative version sources disagree, the 1.8.4 dated release notes omit the merged IPC context change, or prior release notes are lost.
Runtime behavior, dependencies, Hermes configuration, credentials, or user memory data change.
A tag or hosted release is published before the exact commit passes enabled validation and required CI.

inputs.statement: The clean release-preparation baseline is main at commit 54188fb3afaf1f0050d4eb52888867bb2879d941, including merged PR #4.
The latest published release is v1.8.3 at commit dde0386bf8fe42a09af2dedb92d6bd425580087b; the only post-tag change is PR #4's profile-context propagation fix.
Current version sources are 1.8.3; CHANGELOG.md has an empty Unreleased heading followed by dated release sections.

outputs.statement: Consistent Magi 1.8.4 source metadata and dated release notes validated as behavior-preserving, ready for publication after CI.

failure_semantics.statement: If baseline/target characterization, target coverage, exact-commit CI, or publication read-back fails, do not claim or publish a completed release; preserve the prior v1.8.3 release.
